dose: 30-45E6 irradiated MRTC s.c. at weeks 0, 4, 12, 20 (mid dose, selected for further development)

quote: The 30-45E6 dose was the most effective with reductions in MRTC ranging from 92.4% at week 5 to 64.8% at week 52.
note: Midpoint of a range over time, not an uncertainty range: 92.4% is after one injection, 64.8% is 32 weeks after the last. No value at end of course (week 20-24) in the abstract; full text not fetched. Open-label, small n, not TERMS itself. No label exists.

quantity: mean trough alpha-4 integrin saturation on leukocytes
timepoint: trough, >1 year on treatment (RESTORE continuing arm; AFFIRM subset similar)
source: Plavina T et al. 2017, Neurology (AFFIRM/RESTORE PK-PD)
quote: RESTORE patients who continued natalizumab consistently maintained mean trough α4-integrin saturation levels near 85%–90%.

Other q4w trough values fetched are lower: REFINE 76.8%-83.1% (Trojano 2021, PMID 33821693; midpoint 0.80), NOVA 'above 77.9%' (Foley 2024, PMID 39393045). Plavina chosen because it reports the pivotal-trial (AFFIRM) population; assay differences likely explain the gap.

timepoint: nadir reached over 2 weeks, maintained with chronic dosing
quote: With continued daily dosing, the lymphocyte count continued to decrease over a 2-week period, reaching a nadir count of approximately 500 cells/mcL or approximately 30% of baseline.
note: Label words it as a nadir in 12 subjects, then 'Low lymphocyte counts are maintained with chronic daily dosing'. Section 5.1 of the same label gives a range, 'to 20%-30% of baseline values' (reduction 0.70-0.80, midpoint 0.75), not dose-specific.

quote: PONVORY causes a dose-dependent reduction in peripheral lymphocyte count to 30–40% of baseline values because of reversible sequestration of lymphocytes in lymphoid tissues

quantity: mean reduction of absolute lymphocyte count
quote: In active-controlled MS and controlled UC clinical trials, mean lymphocyte counts decreased to approximately 45% of baseline at 3 months
note: Pooled MS and UC trials. Section 5.1 repeats 'approximately 45% of baseline values'.

dose: 150 mg day 1, 450-600 mg day 15 and week 24 (phase 2 cohorts; label regimen is 150/450/450 mg)

note: Capped from >0.99. Phase 2, N=48, doses 450-600 mg pooled. BRIUMVI FDA label 12.2 gives no percent (5.5% of patients repleted between infusions).

quantity: reduction from baseline of circulating CD19+ B cells
dose: 1000 mg i.v. days 1 and 15, single course (HERMES)
source: Hauser SL et al. 2008, N Engl J Med 358:676 (HERMES), Pharmacodynamics and Immunogenicity
quote: Treatment with rituximab was associated with rapid and near-complete depletion (>95% reduction from baseline) of CD19+ peripheral B lymphocytes from 2 weeks after treatment until 24 weeks; by week 48, CD19+ cells had returned to 30.7% of baseline values.
note: Entered at the cap; the source gives only a lower bound. Single course, so not a true steady state: holds for a 6-monthly redosing interval, and falls to 0.693 by week 48 without redosing. RITUXAN FDA label 12.2 (RA) gives no percent, only 'near complete depletion' (<20 cells/uL) within 2 weeks.

No fetched source states it. ORENCIA FDA label 12.2/12.3: no occupancy data (mean trough 24 mcg/mL only). PubMed and PMC full-text searches (abatacept + CD86/CD80 + occupancy/saturation): only belatacept studies (Latek 2009, Shen 2014) and case reports. An ACR 2019 meeting abstract (Abelian et al., s.c. 125 mg, not peer-reviewed full text) gives an Emax EC50 of 26.9 ug/mL for CD86 occupancy without stating trough occupancy; NCT01339481 measured it but no publication found. Not derived from EC50: Hill slope and Emax are not given.

source: DECIDE lymphocyte analysis ('Circulating lymphocyte levels and relationship with infection status ... daclizumab beta'), Mult Scler, abstract; IFN-beta-1a i.m. comparator arm, n=922
quote: Over 96 weeks in DECIDE, mean absolute lymphocyte count (ALC), CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell counts decreased <10% (7.1% vs 1.6%, 9.7% vs 2.0%, 9.3% vs 5.9%: daclizumab beta vs interferon beta-1a, respectively)
note: Avonex, not Rebif. No Rebif 44 mcg mean was found (Rebif and Avonex FDA labels give leukopenia frequencies only; Rieckmann 2004, PMID 15350158, abstract has no figure). Primary product-specific mean preferred over the review.

quantity: mean reduction from baseline of absolute lymphocyte count at steady state
note: No fetched source states a mean. BETASERON FDA label: lymphocytes <1500/mm3 in 86% vs 66% placebo and leukopenia 18% vs 6%, frequencies only. Only number found is the class statement in a narrative review (Fischer 2021, PMID 34831400: 'approximately 20-30%', midpoint 0.25), which is not a PD study and not specific to 1b, so it is not entered.
